newsitem.title: USA: Sparks sees U.S. corn production at 9.48 bln-trade.
newsitem.headline: Sparks sees U.S. corn production at 9.48 bln-trade.

text.p: Crop consultants Sparks Cos. is said to have estimated 1997/98 (September/August) U.S. soybean production at 2.680 billion bushels, and corn production at 9.480 billion bushels, trade sources said.
Memphis-based Sparks put the average soybean yield at 38.4 bushels per acre, and put the average corn yield at 128.1 bushels per acre, traders said.
Those figures compare with the U.S. Department of Agriculture's June soybean production estimate of 2.600 billion bushels and its corn forecast of 9.840 billion.
A spokesman for Sparks Companies declined to comment on the estimates.
In other estimates released Tuesday, Sparks pegged 1996/97 corn ending stocks at 876 million bushels, and put 1997/98 ending stocks at 1.191 billion bushels, traders said.
In June, USDA pegged 1996/97 corn ending stocks at 909 million, and put 1997/98 stocks at 1.349 billion.
